source.text: Payment memo: On 2037-02-18, Mae Reed proposed paying €19.75 to Theo Kline for 3 parts, but the proposal has not yet been approved. The finance team may pay Theo Kline only after Mae Reed verifies the invoice and Otto Bell signs off. Mae Reed has verified the invoice, but Otto Bell has not yet signed off. On 2037-02-17, Theo Kline sent the invoice, which remains unpaid. For filing convenience, the same memo was entered into the log a second time.
